title: NFL year-over-year performance persistence
primary_measure: Pearson correlation of prior-window performance with next-season performance

individual_qb.metric_description: sum(qb_epa) divided by QB dropbacks for the same player across all teams.
individual_qb.unit_description: Each point is one qualifying QB-season pair; players remain the same entity after a team change.
notes: Headline eligibility is 224 dropbacks in 2006–2020 and 238 in 2021–2025.
Strict five-year estimates condition on a QB qualifying in all five history seasons and the target season.

threshold_sensitivity.threshold: At least 100 dropbacks in every required season

qualification.headline_rule: At least 14 QB dropbacks per scheduled team game: 224 (2006–2020), 238 (2021–2025).

team_qb.metric_description: sum(epa) divided by all franchise QB dropbacks, regardless of who played quarterback.
team_qb.unit_description: Each point is a franchise-season pair; quarterback continuity is not required.

offense.metric_description: mean(epa) on regular-season offensive pass or rush plays, excluding conversions and special teams.
offense.unit_description: Each point is a franchise-season pair.

defense.metric_label: Defensive EPA prevented per scrimmage play
defense.metric_description: negative mean EPA allowed on the same scrimmage-play definition; higher is better.
defense.unit_description: Each point is a franchise-season pair; the sign is inverted for intuitive comparison.
notes: The metric is sign-inverted EPA allowed, so a higher value always means better performance.

record.metric_description: (wins + 0.5 × ties) / games from completed regular-season schedules.
record.unit_description: Each point is a franchise-season pair; schedule length is normalized by construction.
notes: Win percentage, rather than wins, makes 16-game and 17-game seasons comparable.
